desc: Garden seasons (scripts/home/garden_seasons.gd; briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 5 rank 9). Every few weeks one zone is in season, in list order, counted on the weekly-event clock (BaseRace.week_now, the device clock the save uses; no server). While in season: the zone's game plays its season twist (unless this week's weekly format is already for that game), the snack patch grows the season's snack on top of its four, and that game's Crown also gives the season's keepsake (rec.keepsakes, once a season per Boki).
seasons_doc: In rotation order. zone: GARDEN.md 10.2 zone id; game: the game that zone hosts (a garden_prizes.json game id); twist: an id in base_race.json twists or in twists below; snack: a Data.CROPS id the patch does not already grow; keepsake: what the season's Crown adds.

twists.name: Hot ledge
twists.note: The stump rocks harder: footing slips

twists_doc: Season-only twists, in the same shape as base_race.json twists. wobble: Stump Shove's per-side push roll (base_shove.json wobble, +- fraction).
